summary: Install-time script reads environment and system info in @apexfdn/apex
details: install.cjs runs at install time and imports `os` and `https`, reads from `process.env`, and branches on `process.platform`. This pattern is consistent with either an install-time system-info/telemetry beacon or an environment-variable exfiltration primitive, depending on what data is collected and where it is sent. The specific destination and payload contents were not conclusively traced from the available signals, so the concrete installer-side impact (mild PII/telemetry vs. credential exfiltration) is not confirmed from the current evidence.
